The '''Star Forge''' was an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] in construction above the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tulpaa]] following the collapse of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. It was a smaller version of the Infinite Empire's original [[Star Forge]] [[Space station/Legends|facility]], which was located in the [[Lehon system]] and was capable of producing [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Similarly, the Star Forge over Tulpaa featured creation engines that were fueled by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

The construction of the Tulpaa Star Forge was carried out by the [[Tulpaa tribe]], one of the most technologically advanced [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] societies following the fall of the Infinite Empire. The construction project was a point of competition between Tulpaa and the planet [[Makatak]], which was building a [[Star Forge (Makatak)|similar orbital station]].

==Description==
The Star Forge was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] being built in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around [[Tulpaa]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUR" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Tulpaa system/Legends|Tulpaa system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a scaled-down version of the original [[Star Forge]],<ref name="TUR" /> an orbital [[Factory/Legends|factory]] built by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Lehon system]] prior to the empire's collapse<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> around [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The original Star Forge was powered by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]<ref name="CSWE Rakata">{{CSWECite|III|76|Rakata}}</ref> and was capable of nearly-infinite output<ref name="TEA" /> of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="CSWE Star Forge">{{CSWECite|III|187|Star Forge}}</ref> At the size of half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]], the Tulpaa Star Forge, which featured a metal skeleton, was much smaller than its predecessor yet still had dark side&ndash;powered creation engines on-board.<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
[[File:StarForge-DotJ0.jpg|thumb|right|160px|The Tulpaa Star Forge was modeled after the original Star Forge (pictured) of the Lehon system.]]
The construction of the Tulpaa Star Forge was initiated by the Rakata's [[Tulpaa tribe]], one of several such groups that fled the implosion of the Infinite Empire and [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] planets that came to be collectively known as the [[Rakatan Archipelago]]. Due to a [[Rakatan plague|plague]] severing the Rakatan species' innate [[Force-sensitive/Legends|connection]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during the Infinite Empire's collapse, those tribes were no longer able to use the advanced Force-powered Rakatan technology left behind. Although the tribes of the Rakatan Archipelago eventually regressed into primitivism, over [[Time/Legends|time]] the Tulpaa tribe emerged as one of the most advanced surviving Rakatan societies.<ref name="TUR" />

The Tulpaa tribe started the construction of the miniaturized Star Forge, in the process competing with the [[Makatak tribe|Rakatan tribe]] of the planet [[Makatak]], which was also building a [[Star Forge (Makatak)|similar station]]. At some point, [[Ruthic]], one of the tribe's [[Elders (Rakatan)|Elder]] [[Priest/Legends|priests]], began gradually developing a sensitivity to the Force, in which she was unique among the Rakata. Ruthic became the head of the Tulpaa tribe after [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiling]] the former leaders into a Rakatan [[Tulpaa mind prison|mind prison]] device.<ref name="TUR" />

From the same device, Ruthic released the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Magic/Legends|magician]] [[Raspir]], who, as a practitioner of the dark side of the Force, provided wise advice to Ruthic on how to bend the manufacturing facilities of the Star Forge to her will. By that time, the skeleton of the orbital station was already taking shape in Tulpaa's [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]].<ref name="TUR" />

{{RPGseed}}
At some point, a group of individuals targeted the Tulpaa Star Forge for [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]].<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Star Forge of Tulpaa was mentioned in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was developed by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. ''The Unknown Regions'' was written by [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Rodney Thompson]], and [[Daniel Wallace]], and was published in [[2010]]. The book includes an adventure seed featuring the Star Forge for use with the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game''. This article assumes full completion of that scenario.<ref name="TUR" />
